releaseNotes.headline: Claude without a switch, Settings that fit

highlights.detail: usAIge reads Claude Code’s sign-in the way Claude Code saves it: nothing to turn on, and no Keychain prompt.
highlights.title: Claude limits, no switch

highlights.detail: The latest ChatGPT app moved its Codex tool. usAIge finds it there and looks again when Codex restarts.
highlights.title: Codex limits are back

highlights.detail: The window fits the page you open, sliders show their values, and tools reorder from a Control-click.
highlights.title: Settings fit every page

highlights.detail: Tags stay legible on any wallpaper, refresh shows progress, and VoiceOver can refresh or open Settings.
highlights.title: A clearer rail

releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.15 reads Claude limits with nothing to turn on, finds Codex in the latest ChatGPT app, and sizes Settings to each page.
